name: glm-study
description: Study and assessment plugin bundling four skills: glm-study-buddy (long-term learning project supervision workflow), glm-quiz-mastery (quiz generation and mastery tracking), glm-quiz-html (turning question arrays into standalone web practice pages) and glm-cheat-sheet (converting study material into two-column condensed PDF knowledge cards). Trigger for study planning, exam preparation, practice page creation and knowledge summarization; the four skills form a closed learning loop.

interface.shortDescription: Four study skills: supervision, quiz mastery, web practice pages and condensed PDF cheat sheets.
interface.longDescription: GLM Study forms a closed learning loop. glm-study-buddy supervises long-term learning projects: it generates projects from the user's materials, schedules reviews and tracks progress with four iron rules (proactive search via the glm-web plugin's CLIs, quiz only after full completion, links/paths must be output, user gates never bypassed). glm-quiz-mastery generates questions from materials and tracks mastery; glm-quiz-html turns question arrays into standalone single-file HTML practice pages; glm-cheat-sheet converts study material into two-column condensed PDF knowledge cards. All data (projects, quizzes, journals) stays on the user's machine.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-study plugin skills: <督学项目 / 从资料出题 / 生成网页练习页 / 做一份速查卡>
